query:
SELECT qcViolation, COUNT(*) as cnt, 
  SUM(CASE WHEN blocked=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as blocked_cnt
FROM brain_council_audit 
WHERE createdAt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 2 MONTH) AND qcViolation IS NOT NULL AND qcViolation != ''
GROUP BY qcViolation ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 15;
